title: Claude Code WebSearch and WebFetch measured test
tester: Claude Code (Opus 5.5) testing its own WebSearch and WebFetch tools from this install
independence_caveat: The tester is Claude Code itself. The test is independent of vendor docs and third-party write-ups, not of the vendor.
ground_truth: curl -sL with a Chrome user agent, python html.parser for HTML, pypdf for PDFs (pdftotext not installed), python run with -I. WebFetch output never used as ground truth.
swaps: Gartner 2025-06-25 agentic AI press release returned HTTP 403 to curl, replaced by the KPMG 2025 trust report PDF (S10)
Gartner 2026-10-19 CIO survey press release returned HTTP 403 to curl, dropped
BCG 2026-09-30 press release returned HTTP 403 to curl, dropped
ai.google.dev returned a sign-in redirect loop to plain curl, ground truth taken with a curl cookie jar (S14)
errors_seen: WebFetch HTTP 404 on a geekflare.com search result (S05)
WebFetch ETIMEDOUT on vercel.com, retry worked (S07)
WebFetch returned NOT FOUND on both PDFs with no truncation note (F02, F03)

probes.question: When no AI summary appeared, in what share of visits did Google users click a search result?
probes.websearch_query: Pew Research how often Google users click a search result link when no AI summary appears
probes.ground_truth_answer: 15% of visits (8% with an AI summary)
probes.ground_truth_method: curl -sL with browser user agent, python html.parser or pypdf
probes.note: Primary at rank 9. Rank 3 was the same page with /markdown added. Ranks 5 and 10 were truncated Pew slugs.
